When Priest of Urabrask enters, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Priest of Urabrask.
When Priest of Urabrask dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Priest of Urabrask from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur.
Repeat.

Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it, untapping Orzhov Basilica
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Blossom Dryad.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

81-512-950.easyPrerequisites:
Kami of Whispered Hopes and Fatestitcher do not have summoning sickness.
Kami of Whispered Hopes has power 2 or greater.
81-512-950.description:
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Fatestitcher and Kami of Whispered Hopes, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Fatestitcher ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
81-512-950.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Kami of Whispered Hopes's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

132-3263-4687-5116.easyPrerequisites: Myr Welder does not have summoning sickness.

Activate Myr Welder using Gilded Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding at least {2}{G/U}.
Activate Myr Welder using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, targeting any permanent.
Repeat.

465-4247-4681.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2459-3184-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Rograkh,.
Rograkh dies, triggering Yomiji, returning Rograkh from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia trigger.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2604-3532-5078-7864.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Ravenhill Flock triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

2446-3259-4460.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Living Hive, triggering Breath of Fury and Living Hive.
Resolve the Living Hive trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

3944-4871-5258-5618.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile Blood Pet from the top of your library with the ability to play it until your next end step.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}
Cast Blood Pet from exile by paying {1}.
Repeat.

457-3490-7328.description:
Cast Animation Module by paying {1}.
When Animation Module enters, Donatello triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers. Holding priority, activate Urza's first ability by tapping an artifact you control, adding {U}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Donatello triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-7374-7377.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by The Lost and the Damned
1618-2440-7374-7377.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Festering March.
Festering March triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
The Lost and the Damned triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Festering March.
Repeat.
1618-2440-7374-7377.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by The Lost and the Damned. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

2440-4927-7082-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Sokka and Suki's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Sokka's first ability and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Ally you control.
Resolve the Sokka trigger, attaching Trusty Boomerang to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

280-423-1437-6628--85.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
280-423-1437-6628--85.description:
Cast PuPu UFO by paying {2}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the PuPu UFO spell three times.
Resolve the first PuPu UFO copy.
Activate the PuPu UFO's first ability by tapping it, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

789-5231-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
789-5231-7084.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Gutter Grime and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Gutter Grime trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
789-5231-7084.notes: As Gutter Grime will get more and more slime counters, the final token you make will be infinitely large.

Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

You have a land card in hand.

Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Groundchuck & Dirtbag triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Karmic Guide.

Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.

Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Aphetto Alchemist.
Activate one of the Aphetto Alchemist tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Aphetto Alchemist token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Khalni Garden.
When Khalni Garden dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Khalni Garden enters, it triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

The Legend of Kuruk's third chapter ability and Fortune trigger.
Resolve the Legend of Kuruk trigger, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Resolve the Fortune trigger, causing you to scry 2.

Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Incarnation Technique, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Incarnation Technique copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.

Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token and a Food token.
Activate the Insect and Food by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Construct, adding {1}.

Activate Nervous Gardener's disguise ability by paying {G}, turning it face-up.
Nervous Gardener triggers, causing you to search your library for a land with a basic land type and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

As the opponent, activate Lethal Vapors by paying {0} an arbitrarily large number of times, causing that opponent to skip that many turns.
